verdict.rationale: Antigravity documents agents that run autonomously in the background, including scheduled cron-driven tasks. It also documents Git worktree support that lets agents operate in isolated background folders, and a CLI sandbox. All of this runs on the user's own machines (Remote Control drives desktop sessions "running across your machines"), and nothing in the evidence shows a managed, isolated cloud execution environment. Missing for 10: a hosted/isolated cloud runtime for delegated tasks, documentation of long-running cloud task lifecycle and monitoring, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can delegate longer-running coding tasks to run in the background in an isolated cloud environment
